newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee May certified stocks 881 lots.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee May certified stocks 881 lots.

text.p: LIFFE coffee certified stocks fell to 881 lots in May from 4,858 in April, traders said on Monday.
The sharp fall in stocks recorded was because of a change in the grading system. Certificates under the old system expired at the end of May, an exchange source explained.
The new system certificates are valid for delivery in July 1997 and all subsequent delivery months and the certified stock total given relates to these new certificates.
